tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the other conditions as per RFP Document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Previous experience of maintenance of swimming pool / service details should be scanned and uploaded.

Experience in the relevant field like, details of experience to carry out coaching for swimming & day to day maintenance like water purification, up keeping the swimming pool in good condition, providing watch & ward of swimming pool, its associated building maintenance and also for collection of swimming fees etc are to be uploaded. (in Government Swimming pool with minimum of 5 years of experience)
In addition to EMD 10% of the quoted / bid amount shall be paid as additional security deposit through bank guarantee
Income tax turnover certificate for three years (2023-24 and 2025-26) are to be scanned and submitted.120 lakhs per year
